item.title: Handelsrush hos Firi etter Binance-angrep
item.title_en: Trading at Firi more than doubled the day after the Binance hack, E24 reports

item.summary: The Norwegian crypto exchange Firi recorded 19.8 million kroner in crypto trading the day after the Binance hack — more than double a typical day — according to figures Firi shared with E24. Activity stayed high over the weekend at 15.4 million kroner, 50 percent above the next-busiest weekend so far this year, chief executive Thuc Hoang told E24. Hoang says it is too early to know whether customers are permanently moving funds from foreign exchanges.
